summary.name: Frase
summary.one_liner: Frase is a content operating system for SEO and AI search that audits a site, researches topics, drafts content, publishes to a CMS, and monitors rankings and AI mentions.
use_cases: Auditing a website page by page for search and AI answer readiness
Finding content topics and questions buyers are searching for
Drafting SEO articles in a brand's voice for review
Publishing content to WordPress, Webflow, Sanity or Wix
Monitoring rankings and AI mentions and fixing pages that slip
Managing SEO content across multiple client sites as an agency
summary.what_it_does: Frase audits a site page by page, scoring each for search and AI answers, and produces a ranked list of fixes. It builds an opportunity report from search data, competitor pages, existing pages, declining pages and visitor questions. It drafts content against top-ranking results and a brand profile, which can be learned from the site or set in the Brand Hub, and queues drafts for approval before publishing to a connected CMS. Content Guard watches published pages for ranking and traffic decline in Google and drafts fixes, while AI Visibility tracks mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Google AI daily. It can also be driven from an external agent or terminal via an MCP server and CLI.
notable: Monitors AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI) for brand mentions and share of voice
Content Guard detects ranking and traffic decay and drafts revisions for approval
Bring-your-own-agent access via MCP server and CLI on every plan
Offers its own agent-ready CMS, FraseCMS, as an alternative to existing CMSs
caveats: Paid plans: listed from $39/mo yearly or $49/mo monthly for one site and one person; Professional at $103/mo yearly or $129 monthly
White-label, client portals and custom domains are only on Enterprise
Free 7-day trial with no credit card required
